Filosofia de Afretamento e Operação de FPSO

1 unidade FPSO (afretada e operada) e sistema submarino de produção associado.

O colaborador deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo sempre em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

• Implementar e reforçar a política de HSE da afiliada, garantindo que os objetivos de HSE sejam atingidos.

• Assegurar que as regulamentações e instruções de segurança e proteção ambiental sejam respeitadas.

• Garantir que todos os contratados estejam cientes da política de HSE da Companhia e que a cumpram.

• Assegurar que situações degradadas e cartões de auditorias emitidos sejam tratados com a devida prioridade.

• Garantir a gestão da Qualidade de Serviço junto ao contratado de lease & operate do FPSO(aluguel e operação).

• Realizar o monitoramento diário do contrato de lease & operate (Afretamento e Operação) do FPSO, assegurando que todas as não conformidades contratuais sejam devidamente registradas através de comentários no Relatório de Operação e/ou por carta formal. Garantir o devido acompanhamento dessas discrepâncias contratuais.

• Apoiar as equipes offshore e onshore na gestão dos contratados.

• Emitir, dentro do prazo, o Boletim Mensal de Medição.

• Mensurar os resultados mensais dos KPIs contratuais como parte do dashboard de gestão de contrato e acompanhar o plano de ações.

• Interagir com os departamentos Financeiro e Fiscal da afiliada para resolver pendências.

• Assegurar o acompanhamento das Solicitações de Ordem Variável (Variable Order Requests).

Manutenção / Inspeção

• Apoiar a preparação do programa anual de trabalho (produção, manutenção, inspeção, paradas), garantir que o planejamento associado seja consistente e assegurar a conexão com o departamento de logística para prover os recursos necessários ao FPSO.

• Gerenciar junto ao contratado o backlog de manutenção.

• Acompanhar os KPIs de manutenção e trabalhar com o contratado nas ações corretivas e preventivas.

• Ser responsável, para assuntos dedicados, pela interface entre os contratados da Companhia e o contratado do FPSO, garantindo a correta implementação dos projetos no FPSO.

• Monitorar, junto ao contratado do FPSO, as requisições de peças sobressalentes para equipamentos em manutenção onshore.

• Contribuir para o aprimoramento da expertise de produção, desenvolvimento de documentos de referência, métodos de cálculo e ferramentas.

• Garantir o acompanhamento de todos os Elementos Críticos de Segurança (Safety Critical Elements) nos topsides e realizar auditorias regulares offshore no FPSO.

• Colaborar com a equipe de Gestão de Mudanças, oferecendo expertise técnica nas MOCs (Management of Change) para apoiar o contratado do FPSO.

• Oferecer suporte técnico em casos de falhas de equipamentos, interagindo com as equipes de manutenção do contratado do FPSO para troubleshooting e fornecendo recomendações-chave.

• Contribuir nos processos de Análise de Causa Raiz (RCA), fornecendo insights técnicos e recomendações.

• Assegurar a conformidade acompanhando questões de Classificação (Class), regulamentações locais e de bandeira (Flag).

• Garantir, junto ao contratado do FPSO, a execução dos requisitos da norma NR-13.

• Analisar, junto ao contratado do FPSO, a integridade estrutural dos equipamentos em operação, avaliando sua aptidão para continuidade de serviço através de análises de integridade ou inspeção baseada em risco.

• Trabalhar com o contratado do FPSO no desenvolvimento e implementação de análises de modos de falha e efeitos críticos de equipamentos rotativos, análises de causa raiz e falhas, gestão de “bad actors” (ativos com histórico recorrente de falhas) e programas contínuos de melhoria dos equipamentos rotativos.

• Representar a Companhia na preparação de Parada Programada (First Full Shutdown ou paradas gerais), assegurando a segurança e minimização de impactos.

• Liderar projetos para melhorar a confiabilidade do FPSO.

Orçamento

• Apoiar e participar na preparação dos orçamentos de operações.

• Propor e promover ações que conduzam à redução de custos operacionais (OPEX).

• Inovar com soluções digitais que possam reduzir o OPEX.

Sistema de Gestão e Interfaces

• Contribuir para a sustentabilidade do Sistema de Gestão de Operações de Campo (FOMS).

• Garantir as interfaces técnicas com novos projetos e desenvolvimentos, fornecendo feedback técnico.

• Manter intercâmbios frequentes com as entidades da matriz (Headquarters).

Responsabilidades

• HSE : Garantir a conformidade com as diretrizes e regras da Companhia.

• Produção : Otimizar os procedimentos operacionais e fornecer suporte às operações offshore.

• Plano de Trabalho: Contribuir para seu desenvolvimento e implementação, assegurando impacto otimizado na segurança, produção e custos.

• Interface: Coordenar com o pessoal do contratado offshore e com o coordenador onshore da Companhia para garantir a continuidade das operações de campo.

• Custos: Liderar e controlar o orçamento previsto e sua execução, otimizando o OPEX. Promover a conscientização sobre Cultura de Custos.

Formação: Diploma em Engenharia Mecânica ou equivalente.

Experiência Profissional: De 5 a 8 anos de atuação na indústria de Óleo e Gás, com foco nas disciplinas de manutenção e integridade, especialmente em equipamentos rotativos.

Experiência offshore é recomendada.

Conhecimento em contratos do tipo Lease & Operate (Afretamento e Operação) dE FPSO será considerado um diferencial.

Idiomas: Inglês - Avançado

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas. Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores , apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

  3. Habilidade em técnicas de negociação e vendas, como SPIN Selling ou outras metodologias de vendas consultivas;
  4. Experiência no uso de ferramentas de CRM para gestão do pipeline de vendas (RD CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares);
  5. Habilidade em construir propostas comerciais personalizadas, adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes;
  6. Sólida comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de conduzir apresentações e reuniões de alto impacto;
  7. Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Campinas/SP, 2 vezes por semana.

Diferenciais:

REQUISITOS BÁSICOS:

REQUISITOS QUE NÃO SÃO OBRIGATÓRIOS, MAS QUE FARÃO VOCÊ SE DESTACAR:

  • Conhecimento em C#;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Java / .Net;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front End - HTML, JS, CSS.

BENEFÍCIOS DE TRABALHAR COM A DTI:

  • Previdência Privada (Para cada real depositado pelo colaborador, limitado a 6% do salário, a dti complementa com o mesmo valor);
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale alimentação (R$890/mês);
  • Plano de Saúde sem desconto para o colaborador e dependentes;
  • Auxílio home office de R$120,00;
  • Parceria com SESC para desconto em acomodações e atividades de lazer;
  • Desconto em cursos de inglês com a Open English e eHeadset;
  • Reembolso de certificação;
  • Parceria com a PUC Minas: Disponibilizado aos crafters e aos seus dependentes (cônjuges e filhos) bolsa de 20% de desconto sobre as parcelas de graduação que são os cursos elegíveis e bolsa de 15% de desconto sobre as parcelas de pós-graduação latu senso (especialização e MBA), oferecidos pelo IEC e pela PUC Minas Virtual;
  • Desconto MBA USP/ESALQ: cursos Essential e MBA (pós-graduação lato sensu) distância e presencial;
  • Parceria com a PUC-RS: 10% de desconto em Cursos de Graduação online, MBA e Especialização (online e presencial), Idiomas e Certificações;
  • Parceria com FIAP: é disponibilizado aos crafters e aos seus dependentes (cônjuges e filhos) bolsa de 10% de desconto sobre as parcelas de graduação e colégio (FIAP School e Módulo) e 20% no valor das mensalidades dos cursos de MBA, Pós Tech ou SHIFT, nos formatos presencial e on-line;
  • Descontos em Farmácias-Drogasil e Droga Raia;
  • Ambiente descontraído, flexível e com feedbacks constantes;
  • Rotina com aprendizado constante, com Tech Shots, Rodas de Conversa e Knowledge Transfers.

TRAJETÓRIA NA DTI

Na dti, o Plano de Carreira Ágil é uma jornada de crescimento contínuo, onde cada crafter tem a liberdade de traçar seu caminho, com o apoio de ferramentas e programas desenhados para inspirar e alinhar o desenvolvimento pessoal aos seus sonhos. O Trajetórias é a bússola que orienta esse percurso, sempre valorizando a autonomia e impulsionando conquistas extraordinárias.

IMPORTANTE! MODELO DE TRABALHO
Para algumas vagas, atuamos com um tipo de modelo de trabalho chamado híbrido, que consiste em unir o melhor do trabalho remoto e do presencial. Dessa forma, em algumas vagas é importante que nosso futuro crafter tenha a disponibilidade e a possibilidade de ir presencialmente até a sede da empresa, na cidade de Belo Horizonte, para reuniões, ritos, eventos etc, quando for necessário.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We're revolutionizing the fitness & wellness industry, and we’re looking for talented people to help us do it. Mindbody + ClassPass bring together the best of both sides of the market: Mindbody is the industry’s most trusted all-in-one technology platform; ClassPass is one of the most popular apps for fitness & self-care enthusiasts. Together we’re partnering with more than 70,000 fitness studios, gyms, salons, and spas around the world. We’re not just another tech company—we’re far and away the leader of our industry. So join the team, work with mission-led people, and enjoy amazing benefits. Let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Who we are
We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As a Software Engineer II, you’ll be a part of a team working to build secure systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You’ll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world’s fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else.
You'll likely spend time working on

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
  • Build and maintain backend systems and applications, tightly scoped work with supervision and support.
  • Navigating code reviews thoughtfully and constructively contributing to conversations around pull requests.
  • Participating in retrospectives as a constructive team member.
  • Seek different perspectives and solicit honest feedback.
  • Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring).
  • Learning one or more technical areas and becoming increasingly comfortable contributing to your team’s codebase.
  • Take delight in delighting our users.
  • Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
About the right team member
You know the best platform is created through collaboration and iteration and you’re looking for the right opportunity, and the right team, to expand your experience. You seek feedback because it can turn good work into great work. You are naturally curious and enjoy learning from those around you. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often when navigating new code or systems. You take initiative to solve clearly defined problems, and you welcome constructive feedback as part of your growth. You strive to contribute positively to your team’s culture and take pride in doing thoughtful work.
At Mindbody+ClassPass we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we’ll be able to build a better product, and a better company. We care less about what languages or frameworks you know, and care more that you are excited to produce high-quality code and be constantly learning. Our engineers work in cross-functional teams that are focused on impact, and movement between teams is encouraged. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to live their fullest, healthiest lives.
You'll thrive in this role with experience in
  • 2-4 years experience in programming large-scale SaaS products.
  • Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
  • Experience designing and architecting backend services.
  • Experience Designing and working with Microservice architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.
  • Familiarity with SDLC and programming design patterns, and Agile methodology.
  • Experience reviewing new feature impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.
  • Detail-oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude.
  • Ability to communicate professionally both verbally and in writing.
Technologies you'll be working with
  • Experience building highly performant and high-quality backends. We use Kotlin, Python, C#, React and Ruby in our stack but we're most interested in your experience building great systems.
  • Understanding of SQL and relational databases.
Have we piqued your curiosity?
Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes.

description:
Landis+Gyr is a leading global provider of integrated energy management solutions. We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. Our innovative and proven portfolio of software, services and intelligent sensor technology is a key driver to decarbonize the grid and helped to avoid around 9 million tons of CO2 in FY 2023. With sales of USD 2.0 billion in FY 2023, Landis+Gyr employs around 6,900 talented people across five continents .

For more than a century, we've been pioneers in energy innovation, and we continue to lead the way toward a more sustainable and efficient energy landscape.

Join us at Landis+Gyr, where we manage energy better!

About the Role
We are looking for a Power System Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud-based utility analytics product with embedded power system functionalities. This role offers the opportunity to be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing and customer support. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to transform market and customer needs into robust software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical guidance to the analytics product development team regarding use cases that require power system functionalities such as power flow, optimal power flow, short circuits, transients, stability, arc flash, harmonics, and grounding.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners to write clear and comprehensive product specifications for design and software teams.

  • Work closely with technical leads to ensure adherence to product-related system design guidelines.

  • Leverage deep technical knowledge to propose innovative solutions addressing steady-state and dynamic behaviors of power distribution systems.

  • Participate in pre-sales activities, supporting the technical validation of proposed solutions.

  • Act as a subject matter expert in discussions with clients and partners, addressing queries related to power system analysis within our analytics offering.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Power Engineering. Focus on power distribution, transmission modeling, and analysis (e.g., state estimation, power flow, short circuit analysis, optimization, energy markets) is highly valued.

  • Experience (2+ years preferred) in electric power engineering, including power system modeling, grid simulations, and operations.

  • Familiarity with tools for power system studies such as PowerFactory, PSS/E, or equivalent (dynamic and EMT simulation) is a plus.

  • Experience with software development and scripting (Python preferred) is a strong advantage.

  • Proven ability to analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into software functionalities.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary team environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Passion for problem-solving and working in an open, supportive team culture.

title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant work environment.

Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.

As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis.

Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health.

Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment.

As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards and company goals.

Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel.

  • Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values are a living reality.
  • Represent HR in the Country Management Team and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects.
  • Be a visible and hands-on partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees.
  • Ensure labour law compliance and provide guidance on employment matters.
  • Equip clinic managers with HR tools to become strong “people managers.”
  • Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development .
  • Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration .
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews.
  • Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition .
  • Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention.
  • Contribute to budget planning and labour efficiency initiatives with Finance and Operations.
  • Measure and report on key HR data to drive decision-making.

  13. Experience working with Relational Databases such as Aurora Postgres and/or Oracle RDS.
  14. Advanced exposure to broad technical skills such as application development, web UI (design and development), JSON, application architecture.

  7. A highly positive can-do attitude with a knack for being a team player.
  8. Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to a varied audience.
  9. Demonstrate strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.

Other Requirements

  1. Ability to read, write, and speak fluent English.
  2. We provide 24x7 support to our customers, so we expect you to take turns with your teammates being on-call for weekend production emergencies or to provide rotating weekend operational support.

Qué te ofrecemos

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global.

Canonical promueve igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos un ambiente inclusivo donde todos sean considerados sin discriminación, independientemente de su identidad o antecedentes.

title: GERENTE DE NEGOCIOS
description:
Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Consórcio

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Main responsibilities

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar atendimento e negociação com nossos clientes, no local para comercialização de consórcio;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para clientes;
  • Prospectar novos negócios, visando manter as carteiras de cliente atualizadas;
  • Realizar a prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Realizar cadastro de clientes e garantir a atualização da informação legal do cadastro;
  • Acompanhar o fluxo financeiro do ciclo de crédito;
  • Visitar novos clientes com os consultores dos distribuidores;

Requirements and skills

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Superior Cursando/Completo;
  • Habilidades: proativo; responsável; habilidade para resolver problemas, matemática básica (demonstrações financeiras / cálculos simples);
  • Conhecimento obrigatório: Excel (intermediário); técnicas de vendas;
  • Conhecimento diferencial: PCA-10 da ABAC ou CPA-10; experiência anterior em administradoras de Consórcio;
  • Necessário disponibilidade para viagens;

Additional information

Local de trabalho:

Consórcio Rodobens | Belo Horizonte/MG

Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido

Benefícios pra você!

  • VR ou VA;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados;
  • Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;
  • Sessões de psicoterapia;
  • PPR;
  • Tá afim de fazer o bem? Aqui na Rodobens proporcionamos oportunidades de participar em várias ações de voluntariado ;

De segunda a sexta-feira, 8h as 18h, com 1h de almoço.

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally to ensure our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We recognize our responsibility and need for change, understanding that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from volunteers from different businesses and actively participate in defining our DE&I strategies. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.
For millions of customers worldwide, the Amazon name is synonymous with delivery – and the Delivery Experience (DEX) team provides those customers with innovative ways to get what they want and need, enabling the choices they make on every order, every day. We combine customer impact with retail invention, solving huge technical challenges along the way.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast-growing business for Amazon.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Delivery Experience Regionalization. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-impact processes and supporting teams that help us deliver on our customer promise seamlessly. This role will partner closely with Amazon Transportation, Operations, Finance, Retail, and WW DEX leadership to solve customer-facing shipping solutions.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Define and deliver important programs with broad cross-functional and cross-organizational business impact.
  2. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of a highly complicated cross-functional project in a new business area.
  3. Delivery strategy: work closely with team leadership to define priorities for delivery strategy internally and with partners, using data to create and communicate business plans to senior leadership.
  4. Product Definition: incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class customer experience.
  5. Support and own the design and development of projects, working through all related dependencies with internal and external teams, mainly Operations, Transportation, Buyer Risk Prevention, and Technology teams.
  6. Develop customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and business requirements, participating in the design of the user experience, release goals, and prioritization of assigned features according to customer value.
  7. Bring strong, data-driven business and strategic judgment to decisions.
  8. Develop business and process requirements, prioritize needs, and manage milestones and overall roadmap.
  9. Enhance Amazon delivery experience, including the definition of shipping prices and shipping promotions.
  10. Bring analytical horsepower, enhanced Excel skills (and ideally SQL), and a deep curiosity about how things work.
  11. Identify and develop opportunities for improved cash flow in Shipping Programs.
  12. Engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy, and outlook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Relevant years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, or technology experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery.
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
- Experience as a product manager or owner.
- Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Description

ADP is hiring a Senior Developer – Celergo Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

As a Senior Developer, you are an innovative thinker with a "can-do" attitude. You will work with teams across the company to leverage technologies that support our backend applications. Your work can include new features, enhancements, and resolving defects for frontend and backend solutions. Those things are important because our products impact people's lives.

Every day, you'll be coding and asking questions that clarify scalability and user challenges. You will be part of an Agile environment working with a team of talented engineers, product owners, and stakeholders continually developing, deploying, and testing application software.

To be successful in this role, you must know how to create functional, maintainable, and scalable code in an object-oriented fashion. You have real-world experience solving business problems and thrive in a fast-paced, Agile environment where you can quickly change direction when needed. You are happy to do hands-on coding and development in .NET alongside a team of coders. Your experience allows you to act as a mentor to junior developers. Our best leaders are great communicators and passionate creators who stay current on the latest technologies. They're always looking for new ways to provide more business value and return on investment while growing their careers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.
  • You have strong experience in relevant skills gained and developed in the same or similar role.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
  • Prior experience that would give you extra comfort in the role includes:
  • .NET Framework - .NET Core
  • C#
  • SQL Server
  • Unit testing
  • EF Core / ORM Frameworks
  • Git
  • Web API development and REST API
  • Microservices
  • TypeScript
  • React.Js
  • Stencil

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer – Cloud Orchestration to lead the design and development of highly scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures for our mining technology solutions. This role is key to ensuring orchestration, automation, and optimization of our cloud-based AI, IoT, and data processing workloads.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Architect and develop cloud-native orchestration frameworks for managing large-scale AI, IoT, and industrial applications.
  • Design and implement Kubernetes-based infrastructure with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) for scalability and security.
  • Lead the integration of edge computing and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) to enable real-time data processing and decision-making.
  • Develop high-performance microservices architectures using event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for mission-critical mining applications.
  • Optimize resource allocation and cost efficiency using AI-driven cloud orchestration techniques.
  • Work closely with AI, networking, and data engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and scalability.
  • Define best practices for security, compliance, and observability (IAM, Zero Trust, SRE principles).
  • Drive CI/CD automation, improving deployment cycles and system reliability.

Key Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and container orchestration in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Strong programming experience in Golang, Python, or Rust for cloud-native development.
  • Deep knowledge of serverless computing (Lambda, Knative), service mesh (Istio, Consul), and edge computing frameworks.
  • Experience with real-time streaming data processing frameworks (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or TensorFlow Serving).
  • Familiarity with 5G, TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), and IoT networking protocols.
  • Proven experience in multi-cloud security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect), and compliance (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps and SRE principles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining, or telecom environments.
  • Knowledge of AI model deployment, optimization, and inference at scale.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and edge computing strategies.
  • Understanding of decentralized orchestration frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to tackle complex distributed systems challenges.
  • Effective collaboration across AI, networking, DevOps, and product teams.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor junior engineers.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

SSE is a multinational company with Italian roots and over 40 years of history, beginning operations in 1984 in the Prato region.

In 2009, we established our presence in Brazil, in the city of Santos, and have since become a trusted provider of engineering solutions and services focused on turbomachinery for the oil and gas sector.

Our services span across mechanical, control and automation, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines, through which we’ve successfully completed thousands of engineering and installation projects worldwide.

Our core business is delivering turnkey engineering solutions , offering tailored services and consulting with a single point of responsibility. We strive to reduce total operating and maintenance costs while enhancing the availability, efficiency, and operational reach of installed turbomachinery fleets, regardless of the original equipment manufacturer.

With this purpose in mind, we install and commission integrated solutions for rotating equipment, auxiliary systems, and process plants—executing both greenfield projects and brownfield upgrades to optimize and modernize mature production assets.

We also provide training, maintenance, after-sales support, remote monitoring, and other value-added services, leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare commercial, technical, and budgetary proposals, considering pricing, feasibility, risk, and cost structure.
  • Monitor and ensure deadlines are met throughout the proposal cycle, from initiation to delivery to the client.
  • Create and manage documentation and reports related to proposals, including technical, commercial, and financial information.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, production, and logistics teams to gather cost estimates, lead times, and required resources.
  • Consolidate cost estimates and define pricing strategies based on established margins and business goals.
  • Participate in internal meetings and occasionally client meetings to align proposal scope and conditions.
  • Support the sales team during contract negotiations when needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in technical and/or commercial proposals, preferably in control and automation or oil & gas engineering companies.
  • Strong knowledge of cost analysis, pricing, and bid documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with platforms such as Petronect, Ariba, or similar tools.

Soft Skills

  • Organization and attention to detail – Essential for managing technical documents, bids, and tight deadlines with accuracy and quality.
  • Analytical thinking – Ability to interpret technical and commercial requirements, assess proposal feasibility, and identify potential risks.
  • Proactivity – Anticipates needs, seeks information from involved departments, and acts independently to ensure timely delivery.
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) – Clarity in drafting proposals, interacting with technical and commercial teams, and presenting information objectively.
  • Teamwork – Works collaboratively with engineering, procurement, finance, and sales in a respectful and integrated manner.
  • Time and priority management – Handles multiple demands simultaneously while meeting schedules and delivery timelines.
  • Resilience and adaptability – Adjusts quickly to changes in scope, deadlines, or client requirements.
  • Results-oriented mindset – Committed to delivering high-quality, competitive, and accurate proposals.

A Ad Clinic é uma referência em estética e bem-estar, dedicada a oferecer tratamentos inovadores e personalizados que visam transformar a autoestima de nossos clientes. Se você é apaixonado(a) pela área de estética e busca um lugar para desenvolver suas habilidades, a Ad Clinic é o lugar certo para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


Estamos em busca de uma Biomédica Esteta para assumir a função de Responsável Técnica em nossa clínica de estética. A candidata ideal deve ter paixão pela área estética, experiência em procedimentos estéticos e um compromisso com a segurança e o bem-estar dos clientes.


Responsabilidades


  1. Supervisionar e coordenar todos os procedimentos estéticos realizados na clínica, garantindo a qualidade e segurança dos serviços.
  2. Assegurar que todas as práticas estejam em conformidade com as normas da ANVISA e outras regulamentações pertinentes.
  3. Realizar auditorias internas, promovendo melhorias contínuas nos processos e na qualidade do atendimento.
  4. Treinar e capacitar a equipe técnica, garantindo o alinhamento com as melhores práticas do setor.
  5. Atuar como responsável técnica junto aos órgãos reguladores, respondendo a questionamentos e acompanhando inspeções.

Requisitos e qualificações


  1. Formação em Biomedicina com especialização em Estética e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Biomedicina (CRBM 6).
  2. Experiência anterior em clínicas de estética, preferencialmente como responsável técnica.
  3. Conhecimento profundo das legislações e normativas relacionadas à área estética.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, além de excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  5. Proatividade, organização e foco na satisfação do cliente.

About Team

Uber for Business is a fast-growing Uber B2B solution serving a wide range of industries. We tackle large problems to adapt and best serve the needs of our customers and communities. Joining our team means making a significant impact by partnering with organizations to fully integrate their mobility, meals, and delivery solutions through Uber's simple and fast technologies. We are seeking a hands-on B2B marketing leader who thrives with autonomy and accountability, possesses a strong data-driven mindset, and can translate insights into actionable strategies. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator with outstanding leadership and project management skills, capable of navigating a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple stakeholders to drive strategic growth.

About The Role

As Marketing Lead for Brazil, you will own the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for Uber for Business's enterprise offerings. Your target audiences include C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies and SMBs, with the goal of driving brand awareness and demand generation across multiple channels such as OOH, radio, digital performance, CRM, and in-app messaging. Reporting to the Regional Head of Marketing Latam, you will lead all country B2B marketing initiatives, manage cross-functional teams, and collaborate globally to scale our business in high-growth markets.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Strategic Leadership & Accountability: Define and own marketing ROI and customer acquisition costs for Brazil, setting budgets, KPIs, and targets.
  • Develop plans: Create annual and quarterly strategies balancing brand building and performance marketing to meet revenue goals.
  • Integrated Campaigns: Launch national awareness campaigns (primarily digital) that generate measurable lift and consideration.
  • Creative Translation: Convert brand strategies into impactful creatives, overseeing visual and content approval for the region.
  • Performance Optimization: Lead cross-functional initiatives to centralize performance operations, continuously testing and refining media mixes, attribution models, and automation tools.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage teams in Brazil, Mexico, and the US, ensuring alignment across Product, Operations, Legal, PR, Media, and Customer Experience.
  • AI Adoption: Act as the internal AI ambassador, driving AI adoption, coaching peers, and identifying strategic opportunities.
  • Enterprise Field Marketing & CRM: Develop strategies for field marketing and partner with Sales, Finance, and Strategy to ensure smooth launches and long-term client relationships with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 companies.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Proven demand generation success for sales growth.
  • Experience launching integrated awareness campaigns.
  • Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills across multiple countries.
  • Analytical skills with experience in performance metrics, funnel optimization, and AI tools.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in Marketing, Business, or related; MBA preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in agency digital strategy or in-house performance teams.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Marketing Platform, Salesforce, Asana, and AI marketing platforms.

If you thrive on balancing big-brand creativity with data-driven rigor, excel at stakeholder management across markets, and are passionate about harnessing AI to redefine enterprise marketing in Latin America, join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware
description:
Job description

A Kryptus é uma empresa brasileira com atuação global, especializada em cibersegurança e proteção de dados sensíveis . Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos referência no desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas em criptografia, segurança embarcada e defesa cibernética para os setores governamental, militar, financeiro e corporativo .

Quer ajudar o país a reduzir sua dependência tecnológica externa e, assim, subir mais um degrau rumo à soberania nacional? Que tal experimentar novos desafios técnicos em projetos com as Forças Armadas e grandes empresas parceiras do setor aeronáutico e de defesa?

Para atender essas demandas, estamos buscando Desenvolvedores de Firmware experientes para se juntarem ao nosso time.

Os profissionais atuarão de forma 100% presencial em projetos estratégicos de defesa, desenvolvendo, testando e integrando sistemas para uso em aeronaves e radares.

Main responsibilities

  1. Atuar na definição de arquitetura de sistemas embarcados;
  2. Desenvolver firmware bare-metal para equipamentos de defesa e aviônicos;
  3. Desenvolver e executar testes funcionais e de integração dos sistemas;
  4. Realizar estudos, leitura de normas e revisão de literatura técnica para implementação de sistemas auxiliares;
  5. Realizar análise e depuração de falhas, correção e otimização de código;
  6. Prestar suporte à certificação dos equipamentos;
  7. Redigir documentação técnica em inglês (análises, relatórios, manuais, resultados de testes etc.);
  8. Manter o código-fonte e demais artefatos do projeto sob controle de versão;
  9. Executar revisões de código e contribuir com a qualidade do software produzido.

Requirements and skills

OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Graduação em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com microcontroladores das famílias MSP430 ou STM32;
  • Proficiência na linguagem C e em desenvolvimento de firmware bare-metal;
  • Ampla vivência na utilização de equipamentos de laboratório (analisador lógico, osciloscópio, multímetro, gerador de sinais etc.) e na exploração de documentação técnica (datasheets, manuais de referência, application notes etc.);
  • Inglês avançado para redação, leitura e comunicação oral;
  • Experiência com Git em linha de comando.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em técnicas e padrões de codificação segura (CERT C, MISRA etc.);
  • Experiência com linguagem Assembly;
  • Experiência com linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL, Verilog etc.) e com dispositivos de lógica programável (CPLD e FPGA);
  • Conhecimento em criptografia e implementação de algoritmos criptográficos em microcontroladores.

Additional information

A Kryptus oferece um pacote bem completo de benefícios:

  • Horário flexível
  • PLR
  • Cartão de benefício flexível que atende os seguintes pilares: (refeição, alimentação, mobilidade, saúde e educação)
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Vale transporte
  • TotalPass
  • Convênio SESC
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida
  • Plataforma de saúde mental (Terapia)

Além disso…

  • Fazemos happy hour constantes
  • Não usamos roupa social sem necessidade
  • Temos espaço de descontração
  • Oferecemos diversos tipos de comidas e bebidas, todos os dias, à vontade
  • Fazemos feedback periódico
  • Temos um ambiente colaborativo, com respeito à diversidade, de baixa burocracia e com constante incentivo à criatividade.

Venha fazer parte do Grupo FAN! Com mais de 60 anos de história, o Grupo FAN é uma referência em excelência e compromisso. Nossa jornada é marcada por dedicação, determinação e a crença no poder de fazer a diferença. title: Arquiteto de Software Especialista
description:
Nossa tecnologia dita o ritmo do mercado. Afinal, 25% do PIB brasileiro passa pelos softwares presentes em mais de 40 mil empresas clientes da TOTVS. Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador. Nosso time de tecnologia tem a ousadia para colocar todo esse aprendizado e conhecimento em prática. Assim, transformando todos os setores da economia por meio da tecnologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir a qualidade do produto, criando padrões de desenvolvimento das aplicações, dados, interface e negócio, e validando os requisitos não funcionais na solução final, com baixo nível de orientação.

Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.
As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

The engineer will design, integrate, and validate Train Control subsystem functions for locomotives suitable for application in both English and non-English speaking environments by using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, and procedures.   • Vivência em arquitetura de projetos front-end, definição de padrões de código e organização de repositórios.
  • Experiência comprovada em code review e aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Habilidade em criar e manter testes unitários para componentes e serviços.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Experiência com frameworks de design system (Storybook, Bit) ou bibliotecas de UI.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • – Transmitir ideias de forma objetiva, ouvir ativamente e dar/receber feedback construtivo.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe
  • – Compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar colegas em bloqueios e alinhar-se com diferentes áreas (design, back-end, QA).
  • Orientação a resultados
  • – Manter o foco em metas e prazos, equilibrando qualidade de código e entregas ágeis.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo
  • – Priorizar tarefas, estimar prazos de forma realista e garantir entregas dentro do planejado.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo
  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.
  • Resiliência e gestão de pressão
  • – Manter a calma sob prazos apertados, lidar bem com retrabalho e aprender com erros.
  • Empatia com o usuário final
  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

Who are we, and what do we do?

At Corteva Agriscience , you will help us grow what’s next. No matter your role, you will be part of a team that is building the future of agriculture – leading breakthroughs in the innovation and application of science and technology that will better the lives of people all over the world and fuel the progress of humankind.

Corteva Agriscience is looking for an innovative, energetic, and transformational IT Product Lead for Salesforce Integration .

The Salesforce Integration IT Product Lead provides product consultation to Corteva’s Agile Product teams through collaboration with both business and technology stakeholders, leading the integration of the enterprise Salesforce platform with other platforms.

IT Product Leads are directly responsible for helping the business achieve their goals by serving as a critical role in the Product Development Process, bridging business strategy, process, and technology execution.

Primary Responsibilities - What you will do to help us grow!

  1. Lead the integration of the enterprise Salesforce platform with external systems like SAP/ERP, Eloqua, data warehouse, custom applications, etc.
  2. Collaborate with Business stakeholders, Platform Architect, Software Engineers, and Global Product Owners to inform and align on requirements.
  3. Analyze information from source/target systems with Salesforce objects/fields, and collaborate to confirm mappings, transformations, and additional data fields if needed.
  4. Lead mapping and requirements discussions with the business to confirm data being integrated and address additional logic for integration.
  5. Coordinate the execution of integration scope, schedule, dependencies, and cross-collaboration within IT and business units. Maintain transparency in reporting status, progress, challenges, and solutions.
  6. Create and maintain mapping documents to support the integration processes.
  7. Collaborate with software engineers during integration development and support.
  8. Coordinate and lead user acceptance testing with the business to ensure integrations are functioning correctly.
  9. Own the product roadmap for Salesforce integration.
  10. Facilitate defining a rolling roadmap for multiple years along with OKRs and KPIs.
  11. Lead quarterly planning and business review sessions.
  12. Create user stories for desired solution functionalities.
  13. Collaborate with IT Infrastructure & Operations to define release plans.

What expertise have you grown - What you bring to the table!

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field is desired.

Experience

  • 5+ years of Salesforce integration experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce web and mobile capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Administration, VisualForce, Lightning Components, Salesforce APIs, APEX, Force.com, and AppExchange.
  • Previous experience with Azure Service Bus and Azure DevOps is preferred.
  • Experience applying User Experience (UX) and User Interaction (UI) best practices in website and mobile application design is a plus.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Ability to view ambiguity as an opportunity to define and drive business evolution.
  • Strong skills in structuring large amounts of complex information within a process framework.
  • Excellent communication skills, primarily conducting business in English with global, multicultural, and geographically dispersed teams.
